description: Reconstruction of the hang glider Bert Hinkler hand-built in 1911-12 and flew from Mon Repos beach.
Full-scale replica of G-EBOV, the Avian Hinkler flew solo from England to Australia in 1928. The original airframe is held by the Queensland Museum in Brisbane.
Full-scale replica built 1987-88 of Hinkler's Ibis two-seat amphibian; the original was never completed.
The Puss Moth in which Hinkler made the first solo South Atlantic crossing in 1931 and in which he died in the Italian Alps in January 1933; recovered and restored for display.
